L1376@P32: BIOSECURITY EXPORT PROCEDURES
L1377@P32: 33. Biosecurity export inspection of outgoing articles - (1) Every outgoing
L1378@P32: regulated article or consignment of regulated articles is liable to biosecurity export
L1379@P32: inspection at the biosecurity point of departure to enable a biosecurity officer –
L1380@P32: (a) to ascertain whether it is or includes an article that requires
L1381@P32: biosecurity export clearance pursuant to section 34;
L1382@P32: (b) if so – to decide whether to grant export clearance under
L1383@P32: section 38.
L1384@P32:  (2) An exporter of goods who fails to make the goods available for
L1385@P32: biosecurity export inspection at the biosecurity point of departure at the request of a
L1386@P32: biosecurity officer commits an offence.
L1387@P32:  (3) A biosecurity officer may only request to inspect an outgoing article or
L1388@P32: consignment if the officer has reasonable cause to suspect that it is or includes a regulated
L1389@P32: article that requires biosecurity export clearance pursuant to section 34.
L1390@P32: (4) If, after inspecting an outgoing article or consignment under this
L1391@P32: section, a biosecurity officer is satisfied –

L1393@P32: export clearance – the provisions of this Part apply to it;

L1395@P32: or consignment may be released from the biosecurity point

L1397@P32: (5) Section 49 applies to an inspection under this section.
